errors.text: The proposed mediator is increasing B2 ordering and precipitate coarsening, whereas the target mechanism is enhanced L12 ordering within FCC domains coupled to jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries.
The hypothesis makes aging time at 500 °C the principal transition variable; the target transition is primarily temperature-dependent, with embrittlement near 600 °C and recovery near 750 °C.
The proposed evidence does not establish the required prior link among L12 stoichiometry/order, elevated antiphase-boundary energy, planar slip, and crack initiation at jagged phase-boundary tips.
The claimed recovery through B2 coarsening and Orowan bypass is not supported by the cited evidence and differs from recovery through reduced ordering and ductile phase-boundary transition zones.
